# CANDIDATE: vix-filter-bearish-entry

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that restricting bearish entries to periods of elevated or rising VIX (VIX>=20 OR rising+VIX>=15) will improve edge capture on J anchor days by filtering out low-VIX bearish entries that fail to follow through. High VIX indicates fear-driven momentum, increasing the probability of sustained downward moves suitable for bearish put trades.

## Mechanism

**Entry trigger modification:**  
- Only allow BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (PUT) entries when:  
  (a) Current VIX >= 20, OR  
  (b) VIX is rising (close > prior close) AND VIX >= 15  
- All other entry conditions (level rejection, EMA ribbon flip, confluence, time filters) remain unchanged.  
**Exit logic:** Unchanged (chart stop primary, chandelier profit-lock arms at +5%, trails 15%, premium stop -50% catastrophe cap, time stop 15:50 ET).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Safe account ($2K equity baseline, 3 contracts minimum; $1K paper ~= 34% headline P&L per risk rules).  
2. **Sample bias:** Full history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18, ~16 months) used for initial filter calibration; overfit risk high due to anchoring on only 6 J days (sample size n=6 for OP-16 calibration).  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not validated against realistic OPRA slippage model).  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: Missing a 5/04 +$730 winner if VIX<15 and not rising (edge_capture -$730).  
   - Max drawdown: Consecutive losers in high-VIX whipsaws (e.g., 5/05 -$260 + 5/06 -$300 = -$560).  
   - Blow-up scenario: Taking multiple losers during VIX spike reversals (e.g., short VIX mean-reversion bursts).  
6. **Concentration:** TBD after backtest (will disclose if top-5 days exceed 50% of P&L).
